caption: The drawing depicts a square section centered on a larger blank page. The central square features a decorative pattern with a beige or light tan background. Over this background are elaborate, repeating leafy designs in shades of red and green. In the center of the square is a circular portrait of a person's head and shoulders, rendered in black and white. Above and below the central circular portrait, there are two black birds facing opposite directions, integrated within the foliage. There are also some pale blue accents distributed in a dotted pattern throughout the leafy areas. The overall composition is highly symmetrical, with the patterned square standing out against an otherwise plain, unadorned background.
title: Historical Printed Cotton
